reviews.title: Technical issues with Microsoft preventing access
reviews.text: I am trying to sign into LinkedIn to this through my work account, however whenever Microsoft tries to sign in, it picks a personal account which of course does not qualify in my work system. There is no option to change to my work account, and that means the app does not work for me.

reviews.title: Poor Quality Courses
reviews.text: I’ve took over 20 courses on this app and maybe 2 were decent. There’s a total lack of continuity, failure to convey information, poor visuals or examples, lack of proper assessments, and no actual projects/activities. Majority of these “teachers” have no idea how to share information. You’ll feel like ur spending ur time effectively, but you will learn nothing and get a certificate that makes you feel like you did.
